name: Marte VR Survival
summary: Stationary VR survival/management game set in the first human outpost on Mars. Survive 7 accelerated days by balancing life support, power, food, water, telecom and electronics, with space weather driven by a NASA DONKI snapshot.

platform.budgetClass: conservative (Quest 2-class budgets; Quest 2/3S likely but not guaranteed)
platform.desktopPreview: Chrome + Immersive Web Emulator (dev tooling only, no gameplay fallback)

stack.language: JavaScript ES modules + JSDoc/@ts-check in MVP; TypeScript post-MVP (SIMULATION_SPEC D12)
stack.physics: none in MVP; kinematic floor drop + sockets (SIMULATION_SPEC D11)
stack.ci: pending (planned: GitHub Actions npm ci, test, build + GitHub Pages deploy)

currentState.notes: Prototype v0.1. Pending: telecom/space weather, electronics/repairs, leaks, tools/holsters, training missions, audio, save, CI, typecheck, schemas, assets. Interaction uses ray + trigger press (direct grab pending).

mvp.win: Reach end of day 7 alive (day 8 06:00, tick 10080)
mvp.pause: time speed 0 (not a phase); auto-pause on headset removal
mvp.tutorial: training bench in the Workshop/Taller (missions T1-T5, skippable)
mvp.health: 0-100 health bar on diegetic biomonitor; lose at 0
mvp.timeScale: accelerated, tick-based (1 tick = 1 in-game minute, 360 s per day at 1x)
mvp.spaceWeather: static NASA DONKI snapshot: one CME (974 km/s, ETA ~65 h) and two radio blackouts
mvp.comms: text only with radio SFX; no data transmitted below 20% signal
mvp.save: v1 localStorage; stretch goal for the hackathon
mvp.input: Quest 3 controllers; 2 hip holsters for tools
mvp.ui: diegetic panels, gauges, indicator lights; no head-locked HUD
mvp.environment: 5 rooms + corridor: Telecom and Life Support (north), Workshop/Taller and Hydro (south), Central at the corridor's east end; airlock porthole and periscope feed

layers.core: boot, engine, loop, scene manager, game state (planned)
layers.systems: headless simulation; single source of truth (planned)
layers.types: shared JSDoc contracts: resources, event payloads, save (planned)

rules: systems must not import rendering/presentation layers
a single resource owner must be the only mutator of resource state
events and save schema are public contracts once implemented

performanceBudget.fps: 72 target (90 only if measured stable), 60 floor (Quest 3)
performanceBudget.lighting: baked/static where possible; minimal real-time lights

testing.recommendedDeviceLoop: adb reverse tcp:5173 tcp:5173 then http://localhost:5173 on Quest Browser

dataSources.name: NASA DONKI (CCMC) space-weather statistics, last 7 days

commands.sim: npm run sim (headless balance report: idle/greedy/competent)
